title: International Student Demand

dataSources.name: Dept of Home Affairs — BP0015 Student visas granted (subclass 500), via data.gov.au
dataSources.vintage: financial years 2005-06 to 2025-26 + 2026-27 partial (locked at 30 Sep 2026)

notes: Counts are visa GRANTS to primary applicants (the students; dependants excluded) — a demand-realised signal, not applications or enrolments. National/sector by source country; no individual-provider detail is published, so there is no institution-level view. Complements CRICOS course supply. 2026-27 is a partial year (to 30 September 2026).
